department: Department of Statistics (Graduate School of Arts and Sciences)

gre_general.value: GRE General scores are required for admission; this differs from most UVA programs.
gre_general.quote: Yes, GRE general exam scores are required for admission.

also.quote: Applicants to degree programs in Economics, Sociology, and Statistics must record their GRE scores on their electronic application.

funding.value: Doctoral students get at least five years of support; first-year PhD students are fully supported on fellowships with no teaching.
funding.quote: The Graduate School offers doctoral students a minimum of five years of financial support upon admission, including twelve-month living support of $37,260

also.quote: First-year Ph.D. students are fully supported on fellowships requiring no teaching duties.

entry_route.value: A master's is not required; many PhD students do not have one.
entry_route.quote: Many of our Ph.D. students do not have a Masters degree.
